full_judgment: We have gone the records. The statements made in the application for discharge involving questions of facts cannot be decided without holding trial. There is nothing in record to establish that the petitioner did not issue the cheque or that it was not bounced or that the notice was not served upon the accused and the complaint case was not filed within the period of limitation. The Metropolitan Sessions Judge on perusal of the materials on record found a prima facie case under section 138 of the Negotiable Instrument Act against the accused-petitioner and accordingly framed charge against him. We do not find any thing wrong in the impugned order.
